title: Run it like a program
story: `filter_plddt.py` starts with `#!/usr/bin/env python3`, so it can run on its own as `./filter_plddt.py`. Make it runnable, then use it to keep the designs in scores.csv with pLDDT of at least 85.

files.~/{{project}}/filter_plddt.py:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Keep designs whose pLDDT is at or above a cutoff. Writes passing.txt."""
import csv
import sys

scores_file, cutoff = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2])
with open(scores_file) as handle:
    keep = [r["name"] for r in csv.DictReader(handle) if float(r["plddt"]) >= cutoff]

with open("passing.txt", "w") as out:
    out.write("\n".join(keep) + "\n")
print(f"{len(keep)} designs at or above {cutoff:g}; names written to passing.txt")
